% A document that comes with its .bbl and without the .bib that
% \bibliography names, as many arXiv sources do. LaTeX reads that .bbl,
% so the PDF has the references: natbib's author-year citations, with
% hyperref, in the text and in a footnote.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{natbib}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
As \citet{one} says, and as \citep{two} shows.\footnote{See also \citet{two}.}
\bibliographystyle{plainnat}
\bibliography{test-bblnobib-gone}
\end{document}
